title: Next up names the specialty pick
caption: Buy Heart Gore 7 → 8 takes the skill to Lv 8, where its first specialty slot opens: the step now names the guide's pick.

title: Phone: the pick on the skill step
caption: The same save at 390 px: the pick sits in the step's line under Buy Heart Gore 7 → 8.

title: After a Respec: picks kept
caption: Lv 39, every line bought, then Skills Respec. Respec keeps specialty picks, so the steps that level each skill back up now say the pick is kept instead of saying nothing.

title: Phone: picks kept after a Respec
caption: The same respec at 390 px.

title: Skills hint agrees with the points
caption: Lv 39 after Mark all spent: Insignia Explosion 9 → 10 is short of points. The hint under it now counts from the 1 point you have, as the header does, not 0.
